(i) we have developed a formal framework and a method for visual reasoning about moving objects, (ii) we have implemented the method in answer set logic programming, and (iii) we have applied the method in a case study on the MOTChallenge benchmark and a Movie Dataset.
(1) answer set programming is an excellent tool for reasoning about moving objects in video data, and (2) the proposed architecture can compute robust visual explanations.

the question: how can we systematically compute robust visual explanations in terms of high level abductive reasoning about moving objects in video data?
